items.title: Vulcan Materials (VMC) Q3 Results Defy Energy Cost Pressure
items.summary: Vulcan Materials just posted its Q3 2026 scorecard and the stock barely flinched. Shares were roughly flat on the first read, up about 0.3%, even as the business turned in adjusted EBITDA of US$707m and a 32.3% adjusted EBITDA margin in a quarter hit by about US$40m of diesel and energy drag. The real story is margin resilience. The market treated this like a routine print.
